notes:
The fake backend (fake.py) is a deterministic nine-value observation and six-value action stand-in for FrankaDrakeEnv in the Hammer teleop configuration; it models no Drake rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, controller, rendering or sensors, and the base reward is 0. It uses that configuration's action_scale [0.04, 0.4] and numObservations [9], so its published action envelope does not cover the default DrakeBaseConfig image observation [10, 240, 320] or its action_scale [0.08, 0.6]. The upstream simulator was not opened or compared: constructing an environment needs a Hydra task_config, pydrake, torch and the bundled assets, and this package serves no sim backend (env_id FrankaDrakeEnv-v0 is registered only when the clone's env package is imported). The fake initial observation jitter is test data marked placeholder. The gate's expected warnings and why they are left: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the state of the next reset, so it makes no native call), and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived integer seeds, ticks and action.values (declaring actions for reset/seed to add units exposes the undescribed scenario/options inputs, as the Gymnasium exemplar records). No hardware run, no human review. The clone at ca358b149f798301beb04542ee873c45daebceb9 was not modified. The final gate run followed the last driver.py and facts.md edit and the reference regeneration.
